title: Explainable AI Systems Must Be Contestable: Here’s How to Make It Happen
reasoning: The paper is built upon the operationalization of AI ethics frameworks, focusing on 'contestability' as a critical ethical safeguard. It specifically addresses concepts of human dignity, autonomy, procedural justice, and accountability, and it proposes the Contestability Assessment Scale (CAS) as a metric to evaluate and benchmark AI systems against these ethical and regulatory requirements.
